summary:
Main
Today, iron ore price fluctuations on the Dalian Commodity Exchange (DCE) were relatively narrow. The DCE benchmark contract I2609 closed at 741 yuan/ton,down 0.27%. Spot prices at Qingdao Port remained essentially flat compared with the previous trading day.
